identity.notes: The catalog code '1301B' does not appear on any page found. MASIMO sells two office fridges in the 1301 series in Israel: MS-1301, white with a solid door (94 L gross / 91 L net, 47.5 × 83.2 × 44.2 cm), and MS-1301BG, black with a clear door (90 L, 51 × 84.5 × 46.5 cm; retailers write 'דלת שקופה' and never say the door is glass). Some retailers (s2, s3) title the black clear-door unit simply 'MS-1301' and name it MS-1301BG in the description. The catalog name ('מקרר שקוף ויטרינה משרדי') describes the clear-door unit, and B most likely stands for black, so this record follows MS-1301BG. The '91 ליטר' in the catalog name matches the white solid-door MS-1301, not the clear-door unit. QA 2026-11-11: Home Center sells a Westin WES-1301B (s6), a black solid-door office fridge with 94 L gross / 91 L net and 832 × 442 × 475 mm, i.e. the solid-door platform in black, alongside a WES-1301BG vitrine. So a code ending in 'B' alone can mean the black solid-door unit, which would also explain the catalog's 91 L. The catalog name's 'שקוף ויטרינה' still points to the clear-door unit; the match stays medium until the box label is checked. No MASIMO manufacturer site, importer page, manual or energy-label record was found. All exact-model sources are Israeli retailer pages with the same copied description. Importer is unclear: netoneto names Digital Electric as the official importer, hashmal-price names LAVAMAT, and the white MS-1301 page names Beti Electronics for warranty. '(קלינטון)' in the catalog name is an internal tag that lib/normalize.ts strips; it is not a product fact.

content.summary: מקרר משרדי ויטרינה של MASIMO עם דלת שקופה וגימור שחור, בנפח 90 ליטר. מידותיו 51 × 84.5 × 46.5 ס״מ (רוחב × גובה × עומק), ובפנים 3 מדפי זכוכית, מדף לבקבוקים ומגירה שקופה לירקות ופירות. דירוג האקלים שלו הוא T. מתאים למשרד, לחדר ישיבות או לדירה קטנה שבה רוצים לראות את המשקאות והמזון דרך הדלת.
highlights: 3 מדפי זכוכית, מדף לבקבוקים ומגירה שקופה לירקות ופירות

reviewFlags.issue: Catalog code '1301B' was not found on any source. The record follows MASIMO MS-1301BG, the black glass-door unit in the 1301 series. MS-1301 is a white solid-door unit with different dimensions and volume. QA 2026-11-11: Home Center (s6) sells Westin WES-1301B, a black solid-door office fridge (94 L gross / 91 L net, 832 × 442 × 475 mm, same as the white MS-1301), next to WES-1301BG (black vitrine). So '1301B' may be a black solid-door unit, which would match the catalog's 91 L but not its 'שקוף ויטרינה'. If the store's unit has a solid door, this record's dimensions, volume, shelves and content are wrong for it. Check the box label or the supplier invoice to confirm the store's unit is MS-1301BG before QA passes. Do not change the catalog model_number (join key).
Catalog name says 91 ליטר. Retailers list the black glass-door MS-1301BG at 90 L; 91 L net is the white solid-door MS-1301. Consider fixing the name; it was not changed here because names drive URLs.

No manufacturer, importer, manual or energy-label source exists online for this model. All exact-model data comes from Israeli retailer pages that repeat the same description. No weight, energy rating, annual kWh, noise, power or voltage figures could be verified.

Importer conflict: netoneto names Digital Electric as official importer, hashmal-price names LAVAMAT, and the white MS-1301 page at digital-electric.co.il names Beti Electronics (בטי אלקטרוניקה) for warranty. Importer left null and warranty withheld.
MASIMO 1301 pages at Home Center and Radio Electric (rde.co.il) now redirect to category pages, so the model may be leaving the market. Prices and stock were not touched.
